question: Notion task 区间1.618测试 stage3: does the BTC first weekly 1618 limit trade (SL 2.0 ext, TP Monday edge) beat the driftless 38.2 percent out of sample?
hypothesis_source: exp-monday-1618-validity-20261023-v1 focus BTC 49.1 percent (n=53, OKX 2025-06..2026-08) versus universe 39.1; owner drawings place stops near 2.0 extension (median 1.9 / -0.99).
primary: BTC oos_pre only. Pass = binomial p<0.01 for validity >38.2 percent AND mean R >0. Other symbols and periods are descriptive.
exit: Limit at 1618 (gap fills at open), SL 2.0 extension, TP Monday near edge; 1m ordering, touch minute can only stop, same minute both = stop; 14-day mark; fee 0.
